FactionDef.label: loners
FactionDef.description: Unaffiliated stalkers who come to the Zone alone or in small groups, chasing artifacts and a living. They trade with anyone who does not shoot first.

FactionDef.label: duty
FactionDef.description: A disciplined paramilitary order that sees the Zone as a threat to be contained and destroyed. Strict ranks, heavy weapons and little patience for anarchists.

FactionDef.label: freedom
FactionDef.description: Free-spirited anarchists who believe the Zone belongs to everyone. Relaxed in camp, dangerous in a fight, and sworn rivals of Duty.

FactionDef.label: bandits
FactionDef.description: Gangs of thugs who prey on stalkers: ambushes, robbery and protection rackets. You can buy their goods, if you can stomach the prices.

FactionDef.label: military
FactionDef.description: Government troops guarding the cordon around the Zone. Well armed and organised, they shoot trespassers on sight.

FactionDef.label: monolith
FactionDef.description: Fanatics from the heart of the Zone who serve something they call the Monolith. They do not negotiate, do not retreat and attack everyone.

FactionDef.label: mercenaries
FactionDef.description: Professional soldiers of fortune working for whoever pays. Excellent equipment, cold calculation, no questions asked.

FactionDef.label: scientists
FactionDef.description: Researchers studying anomalies and artifacts from fortified camps. Poorly armed, but pay well for samples and sell rare equipment.
